descriptions.zh:
### 接口说明
请求语法中Host由Project名称和日志服务Endpoint构成，您需要在Host中指定Project。
descriptions.en:
### Usage notes

Host consists of a project name and a Simple Log Service endpoint. You must specify a project in Host.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sls delete-machine-group --project ali-test-project --machine-group test-machine-group-4 --region cn-hangzhou
